extra_vocab.en: a small flat case for money and cards
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於旅遊、失物招領與購物情境，指放現金、信用卡和證件的皮夾。也常出現在 digital wallet（電子錢包）。

example.en: The store sells leather wallets in five different colors.
example.zh: 這家店販售五種不同顏色的皮夾。

example.en: I lost my wallet on the train this morning.
example.zh: 我今天早上把皮夾掉在火車上了。

example.en: He bought a leather wallet as a gift for his boss.
example.zh: 他買了一個皮夾當作送給老闆的禮物。

example.en: You can pay with a digital wallet at this store.
example.zh: 你可以在這家店用電子錢包付款。

examples.en: Please call us if you find a black wallet in the lobby.
examples.zh: 如果您在大廳發現一個黑色皮夾，請打電話給我們。

examples.en: Keep your wallet in a safe place while traveling.
examples.zh: 旅行時請把皮夾放在安全的地方。

examples.en: She took her credit card out of her wallet.
examples.zh: 她從皮夾裡拿出了信用卡。

similar.diff: purse 在美式英文常指女用手提包，也可指零錢包；wallet 是放錢和卡片的扁平皮夾。

example.en: She left her purse on the desk in the meeting room.
example.zh: 她把手提包忘在會議室的桌上了。

example.en: Do you accept cash or only credit cards?
example.zh: 你們收現金，還是只收信用卡？

example.en: Please keep your receipt in case you need a refund.
example.zh: 請保留收據，以防您需要退款。

extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於天氣預報、戶外活動與航班、渡輪延誤情境，描述風很大的天氣。常和 cold、rainy 一起出現。

example.en: Tomorrow will be windier than today along the coast.
example.zh: 明天沿海地區的風會比今天更大。

example.en: March is usually the windiest month in this city.
example.zh: 三月通常是這座城市風最大的月份。

example.en: The ferry was canceled because it was a windy day.
example.zh: 因為那天風很大，渡輪停駛了。

example.en: Windy weather made it hard to hold the outdoor event.
example.zh: 多風的天氣讓戶外活動很難舉行。

example.en: It will be cold and windy during the morning commute.
example.zh: 早上通勤時間會又冷又多風。

examples.en: It will be windy tonight, so please close all the windows.
examples.zh: 今晚風會很大，請把所有窗戶關好。

examples.en: The windy conditions forced us to move the party indoors.
examples.zh: 大風的天氣迫使我們把派對移到室內。

confusable.diff: winding 是「蜿蜒的」，指道路或河流彎彎曲曲；windy 是「風大的」。

example.en: The winding road to the resort takes about an hour.
example.zh: 通往度假村的蜿蜒道路大約要開一個小時。

similar.diff: breezy 指有舒服的微風；windy 的風比較強，可能造成不便。

example.en: The terrace is breezy and cool in the evening.
example.zh: 傍晚時露台涼爽又有微風。

example.en: A storm is expected to reach the city tonight.
example.zh: 預計今晚會有暴風雨抵達這座城市。

example.en: The weather forecast is updated every three hours.
example.zh: 天氣預報每三小時更新一次。

extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於資訊科技、辦公室設備與飯店設施情境，如 wireless network、wireless headphones。意思是不用電線連接。

example.en: The hotel offers a free wireless network to all guests.
example.zh: 飯店提供所有房客免費的無線網路。

example.en: Wireless internet is available throughout the conference center.
example.zh: 整個會議中心都有無線上網。

example.en: Our new wireless headphones last for twenty hours.
example.zh: 我們的新款無線耳機可以使用二十個小時。

example.en: The wireless connection dropped during the video call.
example.zh: 視訊通話期間無線連線中斷了。

examples.en: We replaced all cables with wireless devices in the office.
examples.zh: 我們把辦公室裡所有的線都換成了無線裝置。

examples.en: This wireless mouse works up to ten meters away.
examples.zh: 這款無線滑鼠在十公尺外也能使用。

examples.en: Please connect to the wireless system before the meeting starts.
examples.zh: 請在會議開始前連上無線系統。

confusable.diff: wired 是「有線的」，用電線連接；wireless 是「無線的」，兩者意思相反。

example.en: The wired connection is faster than the wireless one.
example.zh: 有線連線比無線連線更快。

similar.diff: Wi-Fi 是一種無線上網技術，當名詞用；wireless 是形容詞，可修飾各種設備。

example.en: The cafe has free Wi-Fi for all customers.
example.zh: 這家咖啡館提供所有顧客免費的 Wi-Fi。

example.en: Please plug the cable into the back of the monitor.
example.zh: 請把線插到螢幕的背面。

example.en: The battery in this device lasts about ten hours.
example.zh: 這個裝置的電池大約可以用十個小時。

derived.link: wireless = wire + -less，沒有電線的，像 careless、homeless

extra_vocab.en: the act of taking money out of a bank account, or of leaving or taking back something
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於銀行與帳戶情境，指從戶頭領錢；也出現在商務情境，指撤回提案或退出計畫。是 withdraw 的名詞。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: withdrawal 是 withdraw 的名詞；withdraw 是不規則動詞，過去式是 withdrew，過去分詞是 withdrawn。

example.en: Daily withdrawals are limited to five hundred dollars.
example.zh: 每日提款上限為五百美元。

example.en: You can make a withdrawal at any branch of our bank.
example.zh: 您可以在我們銀行的任何一家分行提款。

example.en: The withdrawal limit for this account is one thousand dollars.
example.zh: 這個帳戶的提款上限是一千美元。

example.en: A fee applies to every cash withdrawal from foreign machines.
example.zh: 在國外的機器每次提領現金都要收手續費。

example.en: The withdrawal of the offer surprised our partners.
example.zh: 這項提案被撤回，讓我們的夥伴很驚訝。

examples.en: Please fill out this form to request a large withdrawal.
examples.zh: 若要提領大筆款項，請填寫這張表格。

examples.en: The company announced the withdrawal of its old product.
examples.zh: 公司宣布將舊產品下架。

examples.en: His withdrawal from the project caused a delay.
examples.zh: 他退出這個專案造成了延誤。

confusable.diff: withdraw 是動詞（提款、撤回），withdrawal 是名詞（提款、撤回這件事）。
confusable.usage: withdraw 是動詞，後面接受詞（withdraw money）；withdrawal 是名詞，常和 make a 搭配。

example.en: You may withdraw money from this account at any time.
example.zh: 您隨時可以從這個帳戶提領資金。

similar.diff: cancellation 是取消已安排的事；withdrawal 是把提案、申請等收回或自己退出。

example.en: The cancellation of the contract was announced on Monday.
example.zh: 合約的取消已在星期一宣布。

example.en: I made a deposit into my account this morning.
example.zh: 我今天早上存了一筆錢到我的帳戶。

example.en: Please check the balance of your account online.
example.zh: 請上網查看您的帳戶餘額。

derived.link: withdraw + -al，把動作變成名詞，像 arrive → arrival

senses.en: the act of taking money out of a bank account

example.en: Each withdrawal from the savings account needs a signature.
example.zh: 每次從儲蓄帳戶提款都需要簽名。

senses.en: the act of taking something back or leaving a group or plan
senses.distinguish: 句中出現 offer、plan、project、agreement 時，指撤回或退出，不是提款。

example.en: Their withdrawal from the agreement ended the talks.
example.zh: 他們退出協議，結束了會談。

extra_vocab.en: animals and plants that live in nature
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於旅遊、環保與公園導覽情境，泛指在自然環境中生活的動物（有時含植物）。是集合名詞，不指單一動物。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: wildlife 是不可數名詞，不加 s，後面的動詞用單數；要指一隻動物時用 an animal。

example.en: The law was made to protect wildlife in the area.
example.zh: 這項法律是為了保護該地區的野生動物而制定的。

example.en: The wildlife reserve opens to visitors at nine o'clock.
example.zh: 野生動物保護區九點開放給遊客參觀。

example.en: He runs a small business in wildlife photography.
example.zh: 他經營一家做野生動物攝影的小公司。

examples.en: The tour lets guests see wildlife in their natural homes.
examples.zh: 這個行程讓賓客看到野生動物在自然棲地中的樣子。

examples.en: The new road may harm wildlife near the river.
examples.zh: 新的道路可能會傷害河邊的野生動物。

examples.en: Our company donates money to wildlife groups every year.
examples.zh: 我們公司每年都捐款給野生動物保育團體。

confusable.diff: wildfire 是「野火、森林大火」，只有後半不同；wildlife 是野生動物。

example.en: A wildfire forced the hotel to close for a week.
example.zh: 一場森林大火迫使這家飯店關閉了一個星期。

example.en: The forest is a safe habitat for many birds.
example.zh: 這片森林是許多鳥類安全的棲息地。

example.en: We should protect the environment for future generations.
example.zh: 我們應該為後代保護環境。

derived.link: wildlife = wild（野生的）+ life（生命），野生的生物

extra_vocab.en: all the people who work for a company or in a country
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於人事、公司公告與新聞報導，指一間公司或一個地區的全體員工。常和 reduce、increase、skilled 搭配。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: workforce 是集合名詞，指整體員工，通常用單數；要指個別員工時用 employee 或 worker。

example.en: Both companies have large workforces in several countries.
example.zh: 這兩家公司在好幾個國家都有龐大的員工團隊。

example.en: The firm had to reduce its workforce by ten percent.
example.zh: 這家公司必須裁減百分之十的員工。

example.en: A skilled workforce is the key to our success.
example.zh: 技術純熟的員工是我們成功的關鍵。

example.en: The factory has a workforce of about two hundred.
example.zh: 這間工廠大約有兩百名員工。

examples.en: We plan to increase our workforce before the busy season.
examples.zh: 我們打算在旺季前增加員工人數。

examples.en: The CEO said the workforce is our most valuable asset.
examples.zh: 執行長說員工是我們最有價值的資產。

examples.en: Women make up half of the workforce at our company.
examples.zh: 女性占我們公司員工人數的一半。

similar.diff: staff 指一間公司或單位內的員工，也是集合名詞；workforce 範圍可更大，也可指一個地區或國家的勞動人口。

example.en: All staff must attend the safety training on Monday.
example.zh: 所有員工都必須參加星期一的安全訓練。

similar.diff: personnel 較正式，常用於公告和人事部門；workforce 強調整體勞動力。

example.en: Only authorized personnel may enter the server room today.
example.zh: 今天只有獲得授權的人員可以進入機房。

example.en: Each employee must wear a name tag at work.
example.zh: 每位員工上班時都必須佩戴名牌。

example.en: Labor costs have risen sharply in the past two years.
example.zh: 過去兩年勞動成本大幅上升。

derived.link: workforce = work（工作）+ force（力量），工作的力量，也就是全體員工

extra_vocab.en: one page on a website that you can open on a screen
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於網站維護、行銷與客服情境，指網站上的單一頁面。也可寫成兩個字 web page。

example.en: Several webpages on our site need to be updated.
example.zh: 我們網站上有幾個網頁需要更新。

example.en: The webpage takes too long to load on mobile.
example.zh: 這個網頁在手機上載入太慢了。

example.en: Our team will design a new webpage for the product.
example.zh: 我們的團隊會為這項產品設計新的網頁。

example.en: More details are posted on the company webpage this week.
example.zh: 更多細節本週會張貼在公司網頁上。

examples.en: The new webpage helped us attract more customers online.
examples.zh: 新的網頁幫助我們在網路上吸引更多顧客。

examples.en: Please refresh the webpage if the form does not open.
examples.zh: 如果表單打不開，請重新整理網頁。

examples.en: The schedule is updated on our webpage every Monday.
examples.zh: 時間表每週一都會在我們的網頁上更新。

confusable.diff: website 是整個網站，由許多網頁組成；webpage 只是其中的一頁。

example.en: Our website has more than fifty pages about our services.
example.zh: 我們的網站有五十多頁介紹我們的服務。

similar.diff: homepage 是網站的首頁；webpage 可以是網站中的任何一頁。

example.en: Click the logo to return to the homepage.
example.zh: 點擊標誌即可回到首頁。

example.en: Please update your browser before you log in.
example.zh: 登入前請先更新您的瀏覽器。

example.en: Click the link below to open the order form.
example.zh: 請點擊下方連結開啟訂購表單。

derived.link: webpage = web（網路）+ page（頁面），網路上的一頁

extra_vocab.en: a very large sea animal that breathes air
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於旅遊、海洋保育與觀光行程情境，指海中的大型哺乳動物。最常見的搭配是 whale watching（賞鯨）。

example.en: Many whales pass near this coast every spring.
example.zh: 每年春天都有許多鯨魚經過這片海岸附近。

example.en: Whale watching is popular among tourists in this port town.
example.zh: 賞鯨在這個港口小鎮的遊客之間很受歡迎。

example.en: A blue whale is the largest animal on Earth.
example.zh: 藍鯨是地球上最大的動物。

example.en: We plan to go whale watching during our trip.
example.zh: 我們打算在旅行期間去賞鯨。

examples.en: The boat tour gives visitors a chance to see a whale.
examples.zh: 這個乘船行程讓遊客有機會看到鯨魚。

examples.en: The group works to protect whales from ocean noise.
examples.zh: 這個團體致力於保護鯨魚免受海洋噪音影響。

examples.en: Our company logo is a blue whale jumping over a wave.
examples.zh: 我們公司的標誌是一隻躍過浪花的藍鯨。

confusable.diff: while 唸 /waɪl/，是連接詞「當…的時候」；whale 唸 /weɪl/，是名詞「鯨魚」。
confusable.usage: while 是連接詞，後面接子句（while the boat leaves）；whale 是名詞，可前面加 a 或 the。

example.en: Please stay seated while the boat leaves the harbor.
example.zh: 船離開港口時，請留在座位上。

example.en: A dolphin followed our boat for ten minutes.
example.zh: 一隻海豚跟著我們的船游了十分鐘。

example.en: The hotel has a beautiful view of the ocean.
example.zh: 這間飯店有美麗的海景。
